message.reasoning_content: All My Loving: McCartney sole lead. I'm So Tired — Lennon. Dig a Pony — Lennon. I'm Gonna Sit Right Down — McCartney too? It's sung by McCartney (with Lennon harmonies?). At the BBC, McCartney lead. But "All My Loving" is clearly sole lead.
